lines.zh: 我们五条一起穿过红树根。
lines.en: The five of us thread the mangrove roots.
My two barbels feel through the dark.
The water is murky; my school leads me.

lines.zh: 红树的根像栅栏，我们钻过去。
lines.en: Mangrove roots fence us; we slip through.
My tail quickens and the school quickens.

lines.zh: 前面一条转弯，我也转弯。
lines.en: The one ahead turns; I turn too.
White flowers float on the swamp water.

lines.zh: 我擦过树根，鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: I scrape a root and lose a scale.
The tide falls; we swim inland.
Five fish, and only one shadow.

lines.zh: 我们从倒木底下游过去。
lines.en: We pass beneath the fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 盐味淡了，这里是河口尽头。
lines.en: The salt thins; this is the estuary's end.
I swim at the back, watching behind.
One touch of weed scatters the whole school.
I press in close along the roots.

lines.zh: 水一深，我们就散开一点。
lines.en: When it deepens, we spread out a bit.
We hover among the roots.
My barbels twitch, twitch.

lines.zh: 红树的影子把水染成褐色。
lines.en: Mangrove shadows dye the water brown.
Someone's bones lie buried in the mud.
I chew a little moss.
My schoolmate stops at my left.
The tide nudges us, again and again.

lines.zh: 红树根下，我们慢慢摆鳍。
lines.en: Under the roots we fan our fins slowly.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道从泥里上来。
lines.en: The smell of bone meal rises from the mud.
The five of us make no sound.
A crab crawls along a root.
I wait for it to fall.
The swamp is never quiet.
Water stirs; every head lifts.

lines.zh: 你涉水过来，红树根在晃。
lines.en: You wade in; the mangrove roots sway.

lines.zh: 我们五条一起转头看你。
lines.en: All five of us turn to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的触须朝你的方向伸。
lines.en: My barbels reach toward you.
That thing between your fingers moves.
You stand in the water, whiter than the roots.
Five fish circle you halfway.
You move; the whole school backs off.
I know the fishing line at your waist.
Do not step in; the water will cloud.
We will watch a while, then leave.

lines.zh: 鳞掉下来，水里有血腥味。
lines.en: Scales fall; blood taints the water.
I crash into the roots and stick.
That blow sends me sinking.
Four schoolmates circle around me.
The barbel on my left is gone.
It hurts; I can only dive deeper.
I churn the water red.

lines.zh: 我倒下时，掉的是我的肉。
lines.en: When I fall, what drops is my own flesh.
They all fled; only I am left.
I squeeze into a root gap and gulp water.
Is that bait, or a real worm?
I smell something sweet and come near.
My schoolmate moves first; then I dare.
Your hand waits under the surface.

lines.zh: 这味道太整齐，不像沼泽的。
lines.en: This smell is too clean for the swamp.
I retreat into the roots, then peek out.
My barbel touches line; I flinch away.
One more inch and I reach it.
The school scattered; only I remain.
I bite once, and regret it at once.

lines.zh: 你踩进群中间，我们炸开。
lines.en: You step into the school; we burst apart.

lines.zh: 我的身体撞上你的小腿。
lines.en: I strike your calf.
The water churns thick with mud.
A schoolmate hits me; I hit a root.
The blow spins me in circles.
You step back; only then do we regroup.
I press against your leg, afraid to move.
A scale sticks to your clothes.
Do not step there; fish fill the water below.
The water settles; then we disperse.
It swims steadier than I do.

lines.zh: 我们并排，触须碰在一起。
lines.en: Side by side, our barbels touch.
There is a shallow pit under the mangrove roots.
The rest of the school has made room.
It carries the smell of bone meal.
We circle the pit three times.
The eggs will stick to the roots.
The tide will take some of them.
We guard them until the water falls.
Of the five, only we have paired.

lines.zh: 网一抄，我和同伴分开了。
lines.en: The net scoops; I am parted from my school.
I am alone in the bucket.
I butt the bucket wall, hunting an exit.
Away from the mangrove roots, I panic.
This water has no salt taste.
My barbels probe the bucket bottom.
Each shake spins me once.
My schoolmates leap outside.

lines.zh: 你放我回去，我就不咬钩。
lines.en: Put me back and I will not take the hook.
The water in the bucket grows colder.
Something moves beyond the roots.

lines.zh: 水里的震动传到我身上。
lines.en: The vibration reaches me through the water.
I stop; the whole school stops.
Not a crab; too heavy.
A shadow comes through the root gaps.
I turn and let my barbels probe first.
The surface parts in a line.
The murky water carries a tang of iron.
We shrink into the root thicket.
It is still coming closer.
The five of us spread into a ring.

lines.zh: 我从它看不见的角度靠近。
lines.en: I approach from where it cannot see.
My barbels touch its leg first.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我们就换方向。
lines.en: It turns, and we change direction.
The water is too murky; it cannot see us.
I count the tide pushing against it.
The root thicket is our wall.
Wait for the tide to push it nearer.
My fins spread, ready.

lines.zh: 它停在水里，背对着我们。
lines.en: It stands in the water with its back to us.
I dart in and bite its foot.
My teeth are small; only a red dot remains.
Five of us ram and still cannot move it.
I bite, then dive into the roots.
It swings; the water shoves me away.
The blow wrenches my mouth.
We rely on numbers, not ferocity.

lines.zh: 它踩下来，我贴着泥溜走。
lines.en: It stomps; I skim the mud away.
A schoolmate is swatted away.
In water we can harry it a long while.

lines.zh: 有人从蛋里把我放进沼泽。
lines.en: Someone released me from an egg into the swamp.

lines.zh: 红树根的气味一下涌进来。
lines.en: The smell of mangrove roots floods in.
Four schoolmates are beside me.
The water is warm, a little salty.
I swim one lap to learn the roots.
Our shadows overlap on the muddy bottom.
Crushed shells lie in the mud.
I flick my tail; the school follows.
Plenty to eat here, and good cover.
We will stay beneath these roots.

lines.zh: 热水灌进来，我往深处逃。
lines.en: Hot water pours in; I flee deeper.

lines.zh: 被甩上岸，我在地上拍打。
lines.en: Flung ashore, I slap against the ground.

lines.zh: 水忽然不能让我呼吸了。
lines.en: Suddenly the water gives me no air.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀到根上。
lines.en: The water bursts; I am thrown onto the roots.

lines.zh: 箭穿过红树根，扎进我身侧。
lines.en: An arrow threads the roots into my flank.

lines.zh: 光在浑水里亮起来，我僵住。
lines.en: Light glows in the murk; I freeze.

lines.zh: 根下没吃的了，我瘦成一条。
lines.en: Nothing left under the roots; I thin to a strip.

lines.zh: 雷落在红树上，水一下发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the mangrove; the water numbs.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有根，也没有群。
lines.en: In the void, no roots and no school.
